display_long_description:
"Picture this for a second:

You’re not just staring at a screen watching plants fight zombies anymore. You are actually standing right there, inside the garden.

That is exactly what our new game on Meta VR is all about.
[media]

In this world, you’re done being a distant 'mouse clicker.' YOU are the last line of defense. You have to physically reach out, grab seeds, and bend down to plant them in the dirt. You’ve got to spin around to catch those energy orbs floating from your sunflowers.
[media]

And when that massive wave of zombies comes charging in? You might find yourself planting a Potato Mine with your left hand and a Peashooter with your right. It is pure, chaotic fun!

That intensity of having a zombie right in your face, and the sheer satisfaction of blasting them away—that’s an experience you can only get in VR.
[media]

So, strap on your headset, and get ready to defend your brains!"
